newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's inflation rose by 2.22 pct in November.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's inflation rose by 2.22 pct in November.

text.p: Ecuador's Consumer Price Index rose by 2.22 percent in November 1996, up from the 1.6 percent registered during the same month last year, the National Statistics and Census Institute said Monday.
Cumulative inflation for the past 12 months was 26.16 percent, while cumulative inflation for the first eleven months of 1996 was 23.9 percent, up from 20.4 percent in the same 1995 period.
The government expects to close 1996 with an inflation rate of 25 percent and forecasts it will be 18 percent in 1997.
